clue.text: One sort of mansion that would stop you from going off

definitions.text: that would stop you from going off

parts.note: the Roman numeral for one is I

indicators.note: a sort of mansion is a reworked version of that word, so its letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A peculiar kind of grand house that somehow keeps its residents from nodding off.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sort of' signals the rearrangement. 'Going off' means falling asleep, not exploding or turning bad.
explanation.definitionFit: Sleeplessness is exactly the condition that keeps a person from drifting into sleep.

clue.text: See 3
One of the 10 26 harassed my role model, externally

indicators.note: the model's name sits on the outside, wrapping round the other piece

parts.note: Kate Moss is a famous fashion model

indicators.note: harassed words are knocked about, so the letters of my role are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone pesters the person they look up to as an example to follow.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Role model' looks like one phrase but splits across two pieces, and 'externally' makes the model's name the outer piece.
explanation.definitionFit: Forgetfulness is one of the ironic delights of growing elderly listed in the linked puzzle theme.

clue.text: One vulgar American unionist taking a line that's different

parts.note: 'un is a casual or vulgar way of saying one, as in 'a good 'un'
U is a standard abbreviation for Unionist in politics

explanation.surface: A coarse American trade unionist adopts an unconventional position.
explanation.definitionFit: Something out of the ordinary is different from the usual run of things.

clue.text: Antioxidant, causing little sleep and high tension on short break

parts.note: a nap is a brief sleep
T is the symbol for tension in physics
hol is a shortened form of holiday, itself a break

explanation.surface: A substance said to bring on a doze and stress during a brief holiday.
explanation.definitionFit: This compound derived from naphthalene is used as an antioxidant in rubber and oils.

clue.text: "Publicly, Des, I'd erect housing" — former shipbuilder?

indicators.note: the quoted words are housing the answer, holding it within their letters

explanation.surface: Des announces in public that he will put up some homes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'housing' looks like a noun for homes Des builds, but it signals the letters held within 'Publicly, Des, I'd erect'.
explanation.definitionFit: A dweller on the River Clyde in Glasgow, once famous for building ships, is a Clydesider.

clue.text: Doctor Nola ordered fibre

indicators.note: the name Nola is put into a new order

explanation.surface: A doctor called Nola requested a type of cloth.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Doctor Nola' reads as a person's title and name, but the doctor is just an abbreviation.
explanation.definitionFit: Dralon is a trade name for an acrylic synthetic fibre used in upholstery.

clue.text: Frivolous Greek character knocked back fish pieces (not filling)

indicators.note: knocked back means the Greek letter is read in reverse

parts.note: nu is a letter of the Greek alphabet
sole is a flat fish

indicators.note: the middle letter is removed, leaving only the outer letters of the word

parts.note: men are the pieces in chess or draughts

explanation.surface: A frivolous Greek downs pieces of fish, though they don't fill him up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'knocked back' turns NU into UN; 'not filling' takes the middle E out of MEN to leave MN.
explanation.definitionFit: Lacking seriousness or gravity is the same as being light-hearted and frivolous.

clue.text: Internal switch made by tree psychologist

indicators.note: two letters inside the word swap places while the ends stay put

parts.note: the alder is a tree

explanation.surface: A psychologist made an internal change of heart.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Internal switch' swaps the L and D inside ALDER.
explanation.definitionFit: Alfred Adler was an Austrian psychologist, founder of individual psychology.

clue.text: "Woman wise! O, gather inside!" — appreciated ironically by grandpa?

parts.note: Joy is a woman's name

indicators.note: the O and the gathering word are put inside the word for wise

parts.note: sage means wise
to fold is to gather, as in folding cloth or penning sheep

explanation.surface: A rallying cry urging a wise woman to bring everyone in.
explanation.walkthrough: 'inside' signals the insertion. The definition is ironic: these are the miseries of age that grandpa might wryly call its delights.
explanation.definitionFit: An elderly man might wryly call the aches and failings of later life the delights of being old.

clue.text: Not behind working table

parts.note: a machine that is on is working
a schedule is a table of times or items

explanation.surface: A table that has stopped functioning.
explanation.definitionFit: Being punctual, keeping to the timetable, means not running late.

clue.text: Having little intelligence, girl gets bad reputation

indicators.note: little means the word is cut short, losing its final letter

parts.note: info is information, which intelligence is
Amy is a girl's name

explanation.surface: A dim-witted girl earns herself a bad name.
explanation.walkthrough: 'little' cuts the last letter from the word for intelligence.
explanation.definitionFit: Notoriety, being well known for something bad, is a bad reputation.

clue.text: Like some off-roaders shift around Lake Deluge?

indicators.note: the word for shift goes around the letter for lake

parts.note: to alter is to shift or change
a deluge is a downpour of rain

explanation.surface: Vehicles move round a lake in a downpour.
explanation.walkthrough: 'around' puts L inside ALTER to make ALLTER.
explanation.definitionFit: Off-road vehicles built to cope with any surface are described as able to handle every ground.

clue.text: Pine beach with lights, it's said, one of the 10 26

parts.note: to ache is to pine or yearn
sand covers a beach

indicators.note: it's said means the pieces are pronounced and the sound is what counts

parts.note: panes are window lights

explanation.surface: A pine-fringed beach with lamps, described as one of the joys of growing old.
explanation.walkthrough: Window lights are panes; spoken, the word matches the plural of a sharp hurt, as 'it's said' signals.
explanation.definitionFit: Physical twinges and soreness are an ironic delight of being elderly in the puzzle's theme.

clue.text: Mirage, after bombing one of the 10 26

indicators.note: after puts the illusion word following the word for bombing

parts.note: a show that is bombing is failing
a mirage is an illusory vision

explanation.surface: A Mirage jet, after a bombing raid, is one of old age's pleasures.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Mirage' suggests the French jet fighter, and 'bombing' an air raid.
explanation.definitionFit: Deteriorating eyesight is one of the wryly named delights of later life in the theme.

clue.text: Without water added, a loch gives a spruce quality

parts.note: a neat drink is served undiluted
Ness is a loch in Scotland

explanation.surface: An undiluted dram beside a Scottish loch makes for tidiness.
explanation.definitionFit: Spruce means smart and tidy, so the quality of being spruce is tidiness.

clue.text: See 24
Sergeant ambushed and cut off

indicators.note: an ambushed sergeant is thrown into disorder, so the word's letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A sergeant is attacked by surprise and isolated from his unit.
explanation.definitionFit: To alienate someone is to cut them off from closeness or contact.

clue.text: You can do this to a bay cultivated without root tip

indicators.note: without in its old sense of outside, so the rearranged letters surround the other piece
cultivated means worked over, so the letters of to a bay are rearranged
the tip of root is its end letter

explanation.surface: Gardening advice on cultivating a bay tree without pinching out its root.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cultivated' rearranges TO A BAY into ATABOY, and 'without' puts it around T, the last letter of 'root'.
explanation.definitionFit: An exclamation of encouragement says in effect that the listener is capable of doing it.

clue.text: It's made after frenetic do

indicators.note: frenetic means wildly agitated, so the letters of after are jumbled

parts.note: to act is to do

explanation.surface: Something produced following a frantic party.
explanation.walkthrough: 'do' looks like a noun for a party but is the verb.
explanation.definitionFit: A man-made object is something manufactured by human hands.

clue.text: Put in another class to correct a text message?

definitions.meaning: to reclassify something is to assign it to a different category or kind
to key a message again on a keyboard, perhaps to fix errors

explanation.definitionFit: Type means both a class and keyboard entry, so the re- prefix gives reclassify and rekey.

clue.text: Woman gets so protective of sex

indicators.note: the word for so wraps round the other piece, protecting it

parts.note: very means so, as in so good
it is a coy word for sex

explanation.surface: A woman becomes defensive about sex.
explanation.walkthrough: 'protective of' signals the wrapping; 'it' for sex is an old euphemism.
explanation.definitionFit: Verity is a woman's given name.

clue.text: See 15
Out-of-control school bus finally overturning in transit

indicators.note: finally picks the end letter of bus
overturning means the letters are upended and rearranged

explanation.surface: A school bus turns over while on the road.
explanation.walkthrough: 'finally' takes S from 'bus', and 'overturning' rearranges IN TRANSIT. St Trinian's is the anarchic girls' school of British cartoons and films.
explanation.definitionFit: The fictional school of Ronald Searle's cartoons is famous for its unruly, riotous pupils.

clue.text: Guardian to an ordinary knight taking steps to secure one of the 10 26

parts.note: the Guardian newspaper writes of itself as we
an gives the article a
KB stands for Knight Bachelor, the ordinary rank of knighthood
a ladder is a set of steps

explanation.surface: The newspaper urges a humble knight to take measures to secure something.
explanation.walkthrough: A Knight Bachelor (KB) is a knight not belonging to any order, the basic form of British knighthood.
explanation.definitionFit: Needing frequent toilet trips is one of the ironic pleasures of growing elderly in the theme.

clue.text: Packing material with one makes a dry bed

parts.note: a wad is a lump of soft stuffing used for packing
the Roman numeral for one is I

explanation.surface: Stuffing plus a single item makes an arid bed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bed' suggests furniture, but it is a riverbed.
explanation.definitionFit: A wadi is a desert valley or channel that is dry except in the rainy season.
